# Awesome AI Motion Videos

Motion graphics, launch films, 3D worlds and games that AI coding models made in code, collected from X with credits and prompts.

**144** pieces · **117** creators · **22** with the exact prompt · updated 2026-10-26

English · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

**[▶ Make videos like these with agent skills on Lookbk](https://lookbk.dev/skills?utm_source=github&utm_medium=hero&utm_campaign=awesome-ai-motion-videos)**

</div>

Since Claude Opus 5.5 shipped on 22 September 2026, people have been asking coding models for motion graphics, launch films, 3D worlds and games, and getting them back as code: three.js, canvas, SVG, Remotion or HyperFrames, rendered to video. This list collects the best of what they posted on X, newest first, with credit to every creator and the exact prompt wherever the creator published one. New models get their own entries as they ship.

[Motion graphics & launch videos (58)](#motion-graphics--launch-videos) · [3D scenes & worlds (20)](#3d-scenes--worlds) · [Games & interactive (28)](#games--interactive) · [Model comparisons (38)](#model-comparisons)

Models in this list: Opus 5.5 (122) · GPT-6 Astra (19) · Gemini 4 Argon (17) · Sonnet 5.5 (9) · Kimi K3.1 Pro (5) · Gemini 4 Pro (5) · GPT-6.1 Sol (4) · DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (3) · DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 (3) · Kimi K3.1 (2) · Gemini 4 (2) · Opus 5 (2) · DeepSeek V4.1 (1) · DeepSeek V4 Flash (1) · Fable 5.1 (1) · Haiku 5.5 (1) · Fable 5.5 (1) · Claude (1) · Fable (1) · Gemini (1) · GPT-6 Sol (1) · GPT-6 Luna (1) · GPT-5.6 Sol (1) · GPT-5.6 Luna (1) · Grok 4.6 (1)
